_meta.apply_via: PocketBase Admin → Settings → Import collections (JSON paste), OR a targeted migration script under tools/
_meta.rollback: Delete the photo_meta collection. Entries_meta is additive; no existing rows are modified.
notes: Purely additive. Adds one new collection (photo_meta). Does not touch defects, conquas_observations, or any other existing collection.
Matches the existing schema convention of using text fields for foreign keys (see pins.drawingId, pins.entryId) rather than PB's relation type — avoids resolver overhead and keeps schema portable.

PocketBase indexes are NOT declared here. After applying this collection, execute the SQL in _post_apply_indexes below via the Admin SQL console or a migration script. PB 0.22+ supports an 'indexes' key at the collection level; if your PB version supports it, inline the SQL there and skip the post-apply step.

Rules match the authenticated-only pattern used across SiteShrimp's collections. Company/project scoping is enforced by application code, not by PB rules, consistent with existing collections like drawings / pins / map_markups.
_post_apply_indexes: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_photo_meta_slot ON photo_meta (defect_id, photo_index)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_photo_meta_derived ON photo_meta (derived_sha256)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_photo_meta_original ON photo_meta (original_sha256)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_photo_meta_primary ON photo_meta (defect_id, is_primary) WHERE is_primary = 1

_field_semantics.defect_id: Foreign key to defects.id. Stored as text (not relation) to match the existing SiteShrimp schema pattern. Application code joins on this field.
_field_semantics.photo_index: 0..4 — matches the position in defects.photo[] (PB file field, maxSelect=5). IMMUTABLE per saved slot per photo-meta-spec refinement 1.
_field_semantics.is_primary: Mirror of (photo_index === 0). Enforced by hook, not by constraint. See hook outline §3 for invariant.
_field_semantics.original_sha256: Full SHA-256 of defects.photoOriginal[photo_index] raw bytes. Lowercase hex, exactly 64 chars. Nullable: legacy rows may have no original.
_field_semantics.derived_sha256: Full SHA-256 of defects.photo[photo_index] raw bytes (post-compression). Effectively required for new photos; nullable until backfill completes. Lowercase hex, exactly 64 chars.
_field_semantics.iso_filename: Cached output of isoNameForDefect(). Regenerated on export — cache, not source of truth. Max 255 chars to stay safe on all filesystems.
_field_semantics.revision: Monotonic per-slot counter. Default 1. Bumped by hook when watched fields diff — see codification-standard.md §13.2 for the watched-fields list.
_field_semantics.capture_offset_minutes: UTC offset at moment of capture, signed minutes. Range -840..+840 covers UTC-14 to UTC+14. Nullable for legacy rows where offset cannot be reconstructed from IANA zone alone.
_field_semantics.quality: JSON blob: { is_undersize: bool, min_dimension: number, warnings: string[] }. Warnings include 'missing_original', 'undersize:NxM<1024', 'legacy_client', 'file_missing_in_storage'.

_apply_checklist: 1. Back up pb_data/ before applying anything.
2. Apply on staging first. Do NOT apply to production until staging backfill + hooks have soaked for 24h+.
3. Via PB Admin: Settings → Import collections → paste the 'collections_to_add' array contents. Review the diff PB shows before clicking Confirm. No existing collection should be flagged as modified.
4. After PB reports success, run the SQL statements in _meta._post_apply_indexes via Admin → Logs/SQL or a migration script.
5. Verify: open Admin → photo_meta, confirm 9 fields present, confirm empty table, confirm list/view/create/update/delete rules are '@request.auth.id != \'\''.
6. Deploy pb_hooks (see iso19650-hook-outline.md). Hooks start in shadow mode per spec §9 rollout step 2.
8. Run backfill for real. Re-run once to verify idempotency (should report 'skipped: N' for every row).
10. Ship client code that populates photos_meta_pending on new saves.
11. Promote through to production in the same order.
_rollback_checklist: If rollback is needed pre-backfill: delete the photo_meta collection via PB Admin. No other state changes to undo.

If rollback is needed post-backfill but pre-client: delete the photo_meta collection; existing defects.media_hash and defects.iso_filename were NOT modified by the backfill (mirror writes happen via hook, which was in shadow mode).

If rollback is needed post-client-ship: revert client, THEN delete photo_meta. Hooks will fail-safe (no photo_meta collection → hash-verification hook skips its photo_meta write but still validates the hash itself; mirror hook no-ops).
Never delete photo_meta while hooks are in enforce mode — the create hook would fail and block all defects saves. Toggle hooks to shadow BEFORE collection deletion.
